dedupe_keys.name: summary table of dam safety inspection dsi reports for permitted metal and coal mines in british columbia

description: A table of permitted metal and coal mines in British Columbia that hold tailings impoundments, with links to their publicly available Dam Safety Inspection (DSI) reports and related documents. The BC Data Catalogue entry says the documents include inspection safety reports, emergency response plans, incident reports and site visits, and that the table can be used to locate mines and identify their owner and ore. The CSV read on 26 September 2026 has 60 mines with permit number, mine name, report link, company, Mining Association of BC membership, nearest community, region, ore mined, operational status, number of tailings impoundments, latitude and longitude, highest consequence classification, and whether the DSI report, independent third-party review, emergency response plans, inundation studies and manager follow-up were received. The catalogue lists CSV and XLSX downloads, the licence as 'Access Only', and the record as archived, last modified on 10 January 2024; the Pacific Salmon Foundation metadata dates it 2015 to 2020. Caveats: it is archived, so status and reports may be out of date, and the links point to provincial web pages that may have moved. For simulation it gives consequence classes and locations of tailings dams in British Columbia for hazard exposure and emergency planning. Related catalogue records include the Mount Polley breach review and the Global Tailings Portal.
